counter_screens.label: hotspot_killed_decoy
counter_screens.purpose: Test whether the peptide depends on the intended interface patch.
counter_screens.construction_notes: Mutate the key hotspot residues to Ala or other neutral residues and preserve the rest of the target unchanged.

counter_screens.label: rotated_surface_decoy
counter_screens.purpose: Test whether the lane just likes any exposed surface.
counter_screens.construction_notes: Translate or rotate the peptide seed away from the intended pocket or reorient the contact surface so the same pocket cannot be trivially reused.

counter_screens.label: wrong_face_decoy
counter_screens.purpose: Test whether the peptide has real spatial preference.
counter_screens.construction_notes: Use a target face that should not be relevant to the intended mechanism while preserving overall target composition.
